title: Center-Aware Ordinal Learning for Prostate Cancer Grading from Histopathology Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.28419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prostate cancer grading from histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) is complicated by the ordered nature of ISUP grades, class imbalance, and center-dependent variations in staining, tissue preparation, and scanning. Most weakly supervised methods treat grade groups as independent categories and may therefore learn representations that do not transfer reliably across institutions. We propose a center-aware ordinal learning framework that combines a pretrained pathology encoder with attention-based multiple instance learning. The framework uses an Earth Mover's Distance loss to account for ordinal errors, an ordinal supervised contrastive objective to align same-grade slides across centers while separating grades according to disease severity, and curriculum learning to reduce the dominance of benign cases. translated_title: 面向前列腺癌组织病理学图像分级的中心感知序数学习方法
translated_abstract: 基于组织病理学全切片图像（WSI）的前列腺癌分级面临诸多挑战：ISUP分级的有序特性、类别不平衡，以及不同中心在染色、组织制备和扫描方面的差异。大多数弱监督方法将分级组视为独立类别，因此学习到的表示可能无法在不同机构间可靠迁移。我们提出了一种中心感知序数学习框架，该框架将预训练的病理编码器与基于注意力的多实例学习相结合。该框架采用Earth Mover's Distance损失来度量序数误差，利用序数监督对比目标在跨中心对齐同级别切片的同时按疾病严重程度区分不同分级，并通过课程学习降低良性病例的主导影响。我们在来自双中心PANDA数据集的约9,100张活检WSI上对该框架进行了评估。所提出的框架取得了……
tldr: 提出一种中心感知序数学习框架，通过序数损失、跨中心对比学习和课程学习，提升前列腺癌组织病理图像分级模型在不同机构间的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: A center-aware ordinal learning framework combining Earth Mover's Distance loss, cross-center ordinal contrastive learning, and curriculum learning improves the generalization of prostate cancer grading across institutions in histopathology whole-slide images.
